scope: generic nonreligious current event-window presentation context

source_contract.span_provenance: MSVC x64 exact .pdata runtime-function regions. A region need not equal a whole logical function: the idler accessor root/dynamic-cast prefix is its own exact region, while the effect-item append routine is one logical function split across three adjacent regions.

exact_function_spans.logical_function_boundary: This exact unwind region contains the stable root load, RTTI dynamic-cast and null gates; the logical accessor continues in the next runtime region after 0xAA440A.

CEventWindowData.note: The type appears in reflection/template metadata, but this non-polymorphic inline object has no confirmed native RTTI descriptor.

locator_chain.chain: CIngameInterfaceIdlerGfx* +0x28 -> event-window manager; manager +0x10 data/+0x1C int32 count -> CEventWindow* entries of stride 8; CEventWindow +0xE8 -> inline CEventWindowData
locator_chain.native_accessor_proof: Exact .pdata slice 0xAA43C0..0xAA440A loads module+0x570F7B8, rejects null owner, loads owner+0x10, invokes MSVC dynamic_cast from CIdlerGfxBase to CIngameInterfaceIdlerGfx (destination TypeDescriptor module+0x501EF50, PMD mdisp 0), rejects null, then reads idler+0x88. The passive reader mirrors the already-proven cast with the exact primary-vtable gate module+0x40B1D30.
locator_chain.constructor_corroboration: 0xAA3EEA..0xAA3EF1 writes module+0x40B1D30 to the constructed in-game idler; 0xAA3F0D initializes idler+0x28 before the manager allocation/store later in the same exact constructor.
locator_chain.cross_contract: prewar_scope_v1_abi.json ownership_and_root and docs/ck3-native-ai/prewar-encounter-inputs.md stable passive root
locator_chain.capture_not_required: The previously proposed 0xAA72B0/0xAA8233 capture and 0xAA4070 cleanup remain useful live diagnostics only; production v1 uses the native accessor root and retains no engine pointer.
locator_chain.frontend_collision: Excluded structurally: the root is the native in-game accessor's CIdlerGfxBase dynamic-cast path and the passive mirror requires the CIngameInterfaceIdlerGfx primary vtable before reading +0x28. The frontend generic manager call at 0xE30E78 is never used as a root. Query admission additionally requires one CEventWindow primary-vtable match whose complete data+0x00 event instance ID equals the current ActiveEvent+0x1BC ID.

lifetime.construction: The manager tick allocates CEventWindow and passes ActiveEvent* at RVA 0xBAB9F5; the CEventWindow constructor invokes the CEventWindowData constructor on this+0xE8.
lifetime.destruction: The CEventWindow destructor invokes the CEventWindowData destructor on this+0xE8.
lifetime.ownership_rule: CEventWindowData is valid only while its owning CEventWindow remains in the manager vector and alive on the UI/application thread.
lifetime.query_rule: Copy values during one owning-thread snapshot; never retain window, data, string or vector pointers after the call.

event_window_manager.capacity_boundary: No manager +0x18 capacity field is consumed by production v1 because this contract freezes only +0x10 data and +0x1C count. The signed count is bounded to 0..32; count>0 requires nonnull data.
event_window_manager.entry_admission: Every stored entry in the bounded manager vector must be nonnull and have the exact CEventWindow primary vtable module+0x417F758. A null or other dynamic type is treated as layout-invalid rather than skipped; manager keep-alive/remove/compact is the static evidence that live stored rows are CEventWindow ownership entries.

event_identity.current_active_event: Existing EventManager current-event getter RVA 0x2706AD0 resolves the live ActiveEvent; matching by the full +0x1BC instance ID is required.
event_identity.EventData_source: SPlayerEventData/ActiveEvent+0x1B0 -> EventData* on the current event path
event_identity.EventData_calculated_event_id: +0x08 int32; duplicate validator compares this field across EventData* rows
event_identity.EventData_runtime_stats_ordinal: +0x0C int32; separately observed runtime statistics ordinal, not the stable definition identity
event_identity.stable_event_definition_key: EventData+0x10 canonical namespaced MSVC string; duplicate validator passes it as the first formatter argument for duplicate +0x08 calculated IDs
event_identity.EventData_source_location: +0x240 object; duplicate validator resolves the new and previous source-location strings for the second and third formatter arguments
event_identity.identity_query_rule: Copy +0x08/+0x0C/+0x10 only after the complete ActiveEvent instance ID is matched; validate MSVC string bounds and repeat the ActiveEvent/EventData pointer plus numeric/string observation before returning. Never publish the EventData pointer.
event_identity.GetScope: GUI callback RVA 0x16D0990 resolves data+0x00 through EventManager and returns the live ActiveEvent pointer; it does not publish a stable cross-process scope identity.

CEventOptionItem.shown: membership in the materialized option-item vector
CEventOptionItem.native_index_identity: native_option_index is authored identity; production v1 requires it nonnegative and unique across the materialized vector. cancel is derived only by equality with data+0x2C, so uniqueness also bounds cancel=true to at most one row.

OptionEffectItem.trait_payload: +0x00 CTrait* only when kind=0; publish only a validated loaded-DB native ID and canonical stable key
OptionEffectItem.scheme_type_payload: +0x08 CSchemeType* only when kind=3; publish only a validated canonical scheme type key
OptionEffectItem.inactive_payload_rule: The non-kind payload can contain an engine fallback/sentinel and must never be interpreted or published.
OptionEffectItem.gain: +0x14 uint8; trait add/remove and stress increase/decrease only; death/scheme raw true is mechanical and not a typed direction or utility
OptionEffectItem.affected_by_trait: +0x15 uint8; meaningful only for stress_impact aggregation
OptionEffectItem.critical: +0x16 uint8; meaningful only for stress and indicates post-aggregate stress level exceeds the pre-level
OptionEffectItem.semantic_boundary: These are engine-materialized GUI effect indicators, not a complete or executable effect preview. See docs/ck3-native-ai/event-effect-indicators.md.
OptionEffectItem.payload_source_contract: event_option_1_19_0_6_abi.json verifies the indicator visitor, payload getters, effect identifier registry, trait resolver and CStartSchemeEffect stable-type chain.

native_ai_selector.regular_scan: authored order; raw context-mode gate, required trigger and first-valid-exclusive semantics
native_ai_selector.fallback_scan: only when regular candidate count is zero; fallback flag only
native_ai_selector.weight_precedence: ai_will_select when its presence field is nonzero, otherwise ai_chance
native_ai_selector.all_nonpositive_draw: decision_value modulo candidate count in authored order

do_not_call_yet: Do not call trigger, name, preview or effect functions from a worker thread.
Do not call loaded-effect executor RVA 0x3380410 for preview.
Do not retain engine-owned pointers after the owning-thread snapshot.
Do not infer a stable event key from an ActiveEvent pointer: copy and validate EventData+0x10 through the exact +0x1B0 definition path and publish no pointer. Stable scope IDs remain unknown.
Do not call an event option executor from current-event-window-context-v1; it is a read-only application-main copy only.

request.expected_revision: positive uint64; must equal the bridge's current published revision
request.event_instance_id: positive complete generation-bearing ActiveEvent instance ID; must equal the same-revision snapshot
